name: CoreConnect
intent: Core Connect V2: the WC3 admin workspace and the app marketplace merged into one app. A single CoreAppSidebar, branded "Core Connect", stacks a pinned Home with the installed apps directly beneath it (no divider — Home lands on those apps), then the admin perspectives under a "Studio" label, then a pinned Marketplace entry — separated by the dividers CoreAppSidebar draws between nav groups, in the expanded sidebar and the collapsed rail alike. Home is always present and behaves like the standalone installer's: an install CTA while nothing is installed, an app launcher once apps exist. Installing an app from the Marketplace adds it straight to the apps section, so the end-user and admin journeys share one shell instead of the two portals V1 shipped.
when: Showing Core Connect as one product rather than a separate admin portal and end-user portal
A workspace whose sidebar must carry a Home, installed apps, its own admin nav, and a marketplace entry at once
Demonstrating install-to-sidebar: an app installed from the store appears in the nav without leaving the app
A sidebar whose section boundaries must stay legible when collapsed to an icon rail
whenNot: The V1 two-portal split, where the admin side stands alone -> use WC3 Workspace
The V1 end-user portal, where the marketplace IS the whole app -> use AppInstaller
A content page rendered inside an existing app shell -> use a content-only template

chooseOver.because: WC3 Workspace is the V1 admin portal alone. Core Connect adds the installed-apps section and the Marketplace surface to the same rail, so admin and end-user journeys live in one app.
AppInstaller is the V1 end-user portal, where the store is the entire app. Core Connect keeps the same store as one surface beside the admin perspectives.

allowedPlacement: route-level workspace surface that owns the full window

extracted: the admin perspectives and their tabs from CoreWC3Workspace, unchanged
the app catalogue, install lifecycle and App Store surface from AppInstaller, extracted to app-marketplace-shared.tsx and shared by both releases
the sidebar stack from CoreAppSidebar's group separators, pinned Home, brandName, and pinned marketplace entry
the Home surface (install CTA / app launcher) from AppInstaller, unchanged

lineage.confidence: unset — prototype, no held-out eval yet
notes: Implemented as CoreWC3Workspace with `withMarketplace` set — a thin alias, not a fork, so V1 and V2 cannot drift
App catalog is sample data; install/uninstall is local state only and resets on reload
Every admin tab body is still an Empty placeholder wherever V1's is — this merge changes the shell, not the content
The installed-apps section and its divider are absent until the first app is installed
The perspectives ARE the Studio section — Analysis, Processes, Pipelines, Products, Lineage, Ontology carry the "Studio" group label rather than sitting beside a second settings list
Home carries no divider beneath it: it lands on the installed apps listed directly below, so the two read as one section
Landed alongside a CoreAppSidebar fix: the collapsed rail now draws the same group dividers the expanded sidebar does, instead of flattening every group into one run of icons
